scope: First H0.1 closed-loop runtime pilot: transfer only the SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 incremental local rebuild capability into a fresh current-main branch, prove production diff equivalence, rerun focused/C24/graphical/full regression and exact-head review/PC0/recovery gates, then stop at merge-ready checkpoint proposal without runtime merge.
required_outputs: Director-dispatched bounded C22 runtime Work Order
Focused C22 and C24 exact-head evidence
Post-build critique, Evidence Map, Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS
stop_conditions: Current main moves before fresh branch creation or before evidence freeze without an accepted audit
Any path outside the bounded C22 convergence scope is required
Any canonical architecture/ownership/schema change is required
Production diff equivalence to SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22 cannot be proven
More than one autonomous runtime worker would be required
Runtime merge is requested before H0_1_PASS + C22 SOURCE_ACCEPTED_MERGE_READY
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first harness-controlled runtime-development pilot.
The accepted C22 source branch is highly divergent from current main and must be transferred selectively, not merged wholesale.
Incorrect proxy rebuild behavior can silently corrupt large-structure presentation while authoritative Construction truth remains unchanged.

design_brief.problem_statement: C22 incremental local rebuild is SOURCE_ACCEPTED on an old branch, while current main has advanced hundreds of control/integration commits. H0.1 must converge the accepted capability onto current main without importing stale branch history or changing Construction truth.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical main 1112d1f7 / registry generation 75 contains H0.0 and the control harness, but not the accepted C22 production diff. The source C22 branch remains accepted evidence and requires main convergence refresh.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A fresh current-main branch contains only the accepted C22 production/runtime/test/validation delta plus H0.1 execution evidence. Eligible local mutations rebuild dirty sections plus bounded neighbor context, unchanged section artifacts are reused, unsupported cases fall back safely to full compile, and C24/full regression behavior remains unchanged.
alternatives_considered: Merge the old C22 branch wholesale
Selective capability transfer with exact source diff equivalence and full revalidation
design_brief.selected_design: Create a fresh branch from exact current main after Director dispatch. Transfer only SOURCE_ACCEPTED C22-owned production/test/validation files from accepted source evidence, compare the resulting production diff against the accepted source delta, then rerun all focused, graphical, full regression and review gates.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves current canonical history, minimizes scope, makes equivalence reviewable, and treats the old branch as evidence rather than authority.
dependencies: C22 SOURCE_ACCEPTED passport and PR #59 evidence
expected_risks: Source branch divergence hides unrelated historical changes
Accepted source files depend on watched current-main files that changed semantically
Graphical output regresses despite focused tests passing
validation_plan: HIGH pre-build review before Director dispatch
Create fresh branch from exact current main only after dispatch
Prove transferred production diff equivalence to accepted C22 source
Run C22 focused, C24 contracts, C22 graphical and full world/core regression
Run standard and directional PC0 and require NON_RED
Complete recovery drill, Evidence Map, independent Reviewer and Verifier
Open Draft PR and stop at H0_1_PASS + C22 SOURCE_ACCEPTED_MERGE_READY

notes: Fail-closed repair for a canonical schema violation discovered by the exact-Windows control interface after runtime regression PASS. work_order_type=RUNTIME was never a valid distributed_world_simulator.work_order.v1 enum value; this implementation Work Order is classified as IMPLEMENTATION. C22 runtime blobs are unchanged. Verification remains blocked until the repair ledger, independent review and Director redispatch are complete.
